recommendedTextbook.title: Countdown to WASSCE/SSCE English Language
recommendedTextbook.author: O. Ogunsanwo and C. E. Oyetunde
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

subtopics: Inversion after negative adverbials (Never have I..., Seldom does...)
Cleft sentences for emphasis (It was... that...)
Conditional clause inversion (Had I known..., Were they to...)
objectives: Rewrite standard sentences using inverted negative structures
Construct cleft sentences to emphasize contrastive arguments
Demonstrate mastery of advanced sentence variety in WASSCE writing

topics.topic: Registers of Specific Professions: Law, Medicine and Aviation
subtopics: Legal vocabulary: Plaintiff, defendant, affidavit, jurisprudence
Medical terminology: Prognosis, triage, diagnosis, intensive care
Aviation and maritime terminology: Altitude, pitch, starboard, navigation
objectives: Identify professional registers in context passages
Replace colloquial phrases with appropriate technical registers
Score full marks on the WAEC vocabulary registers section

topics.topic: Articles for Publication in National Dailies
subtopics: Title capitalization, author designation, and engaging introductory hook
Analyzing public policies, social crises, or national infrastructure
objectives: Draft a 500-word feature article suitable for The Guardian or Punch
Incorporate persuasive rhetorical devices and balanced commentary
Format heading and byline according to examination guidelines

topics.topic: Oral English: Stress Patterns and Emphatic Stress
subtopics: Word stress rules for disyllabic and polysyllabic words
Noun-verb pairs with shifting stress (ex'port vs 'export)
Emphatic and contrastive sentence stress in dialogue
objectives: Mark primary stress marks accurately on multi-syllabic words
Differentiate noun and verb pronunciation via syllable prominence
Identify the presupposition of emphatically stressed words in dialogue
